captions.detailed: A wall-mounted air purifier with a light gray rectangular chassis, featuring a vertically slatted front faceplate that acts as an air intake. A dark accent handle or latch is visible near the top edge. The front cover is designed to pivot outward on a vertical hinge located on one side, while an internal filter drawer can slide straight forward on bottom guide rails for maintenance.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-mounted air purifier in CadQuery. The model should feature a main outer frame, a hinged front cover that rotates on a vertical side hinge, and an inner filter drawer that slides forward along bottom guide rails. Apply a light gray finish to the main body and a dark finish to the accent handle.
captions.factory: Construct the main chassis using a hollowed box primitive with open front faces. Model the front cover by subtracting vertical slots from a thin rectangular plate, adding a small handle block at the top. Model the inner filter drawer as a simplified box with guide rails. Define a revolute joint for the front cover's side hinge and a prismatic joint for the filter drawer's forward sliding motion.
